title: 600i Explorer (Origin Jumpworks, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The 600i Explorer is a modular luxury explorer from Origin Jumpworks in Star Citizen for a crew of up to five. Pilot and co-pilot sit on the bridge; the Explorer module puts a scanning station where the touring version has its lounge. The pilot uses the common controls.

panels.name: 600i Explorer: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the 600i Explorer's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Cargo (44 SCU)
controls.text: The 600i Explorer holds 44 SCU of cargo. The goods travel in standard boxes.
controls.context: Cargo is counted in SCU (standard cargo units, boxes of one fixed size). Traders fill the hold at stations and outposts.

controls.name: Utility hardpoints
controls.text: Extra mounting points for utility equipment, which helps on exploration trips.
controls.context: They come with the Explorer module, which is built for long trips to unknown places.

areas.name: Crew stations
areas.text: The other seats and stations of the ship besides the pilot's.

panels.name: 600i Explorer: crew stations
panels.text: These are the seats and stations of the 600i Explorer besides the pilot's seat.
panels.context: Each crew member sits at a station of their own; the pilot flies while the others work turrets or other equipment.

controls.name: Scanning station
controls.text: A crew station for scanning, where the lounge is in the touring version.
controls.context: A crew member there studies planets and ships while the pilot flies.
